title: Building synthetic vowel audio
description: You can follow component waveforms into a single audio array.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: vowel combines a fundamental sine wave with two harmonics. You multiply the combination by a fade envelope before returning it.
silence returns small random noise values. Its output models a faint background rather than an array of zeros.

steps.question: Do the two vowel calls use the same fundamental frequency?
steps.answer: No. The two calls supply different f0 values.

steps.description: You concatenate background and vowel segments, then plot the resulting audio array. The supplied recording has no rendered waveform or text output to inspect.
